class.name: GnamApplication
class.description: This class is used for Gnam monitoring applications.

attribute.name: RootOutputFile
attribute.description: Root output file prefix and path (ie /tmp/gnam-out))

attribute.name: UpdateFreqEvt
attribute.description: Gnam will publish histograms on the OH every UpdateFreqEvt events

attribute.name: UpdateFreqSec
attribute.description: Gnam will publish histograms on the OH server every UpdateFreqSec seconds

attribute.name: DumpEnabled
attribute.description: Enable and disable the histogram dumping on the root file

attribute.name: DumpFreqEvt
attribute.description: Gnam will dump the histogram on the output file every DumpFreqEvt events. If set to 0, histograms will be dumped only at the EOR

attribute.name: ChannelsToPublish
attribute.description: Gnam will publish on the OH up to ChannelsToPublish channels (bins) at each publication step

attribute.name: EventThreadExitTimeout
attribute.description: Timeout (seconds) for event thread to exit at EOR.

relationship.name: Libraries
relationship.description: Libraries to be load by Gnam

relationship.name: SamplerSpecification
relationship.description: Sampling address and selection criteria for the EMON service.

class.name: GnamBaseLibrary
class.description: Simplest implementation of the GnamLibrary class. If your library does not need any specific parameter, you should use this class.

attribute.name: OldConfigurationArray
attribute.description: Variable to hold text configuration parameters for the old-configuration-style libraries

class.name: GnamLibrary
class.description: This class defines the minimal information needed by gnam to load a library.

attribute.name: PathToFile
attribute.description: Library file. The path can be absolute or relative to LD_LIBRARY_PATH

attribute.name: ThirdPartyLibraries
attribute.description: Third-party libraries that are loaded once and never unloaded.
